message.content:
Based on the provided screenshot, here is the design QA critique:

**(1) Human Figure Appearance**
The figure on the left looks like a **filled, volumetric mannequin**. It has a solid, light-beige fill with subtle shading that gives it a 3D form rather than appearing as a flat outline or stick figure.

**(2) Measurement Lines Readability**
The measurement lines are **readable as tapes**. They are rendered as distinct yellow bands with a slight thickness and opacity that wrap around the body's contours (visible clearly at the neck and waist), effectively simulating the look of a physical measuring tape.

**(3) Top-Left Card Composition**
The top-left "Interactive Diagram" card is **well-composed**. The figure is fully contained within the white container with adequate padding. The labels for each measurement point are positioned cleanly to the sides of the figure without overlapping the body or colliding with one another. Nothing appears cut off or clipped by the card boundaries.

**(4) Right-Side Measurement Card Description**
Yes, the right-side card contains an **illustrated close-up diagram**. It features a zoomed-in view of the upper torso and neck area of the same mannequin style. It includes a dashed vertical center line and a prominent yellow "collar line" wrapping the neck. A dark blue pill-shaped button ("Snug at the base of the neck") overlays the diagram to highlight the specific action required.

**(5) Visual Bugs & Issues**
*   **No critical visual bugs:** There are no instances of text overlapping illegibly or elements being harshly clipped.
*   **Minor Observation:** In the bottom section ("Save your numbers"), the dark blue card on the right ("Nothing saved yet") has significantly more vertical height than the input form on the left, creating a slight layout imbalance, though this is likely due to the amount of text content within it.
